aoi_handling.method: retain source pixels whose geographic footprints intersect canonical bbox; represent each intersecting footprint by its clipped-AOI intersection centroid

temporal_coverage.gap_assessment: Missing slots correspond to absent source GeoTIFF filenames; the ingestion process does not interpolate, fill, or silently discard timestamps.

value_interpretation.normalized_rainfall_mm: raw rain rate multiplied by 0.5 hour

model_input_compatibility.p5: not substituted; validated P5 remains explicitly synthetic-fixture-only
